summary: Iteration 29: tested Channel Drag Reorder and Rename on /live-ops. Backend: 38/38 pytest pass. That is 9 new tests in test_iter29_team_channel_config.py plus the iter27/28 regression. GET/PUT /api/team/channel-config works: unauth gets 401, there is no _id or team_id in the response, order is de-duplicated, names are trimmed, empty names are dropped, a 41-character name gets 422 and 40 characters is OK, bad types get 422, crew can write, guest gets 403 on write, and the config is separate per team. Frontend: on first load the feature could not be used at all, and there was a second bug that blocked touch drag. The tester fixed both. After the fixes, everything else works. Mouse drag via the handle moved a Smart tools card (dhTension) in front of the Pressures card whp. Keyboard drag works (Space, ArrowRight, Space). The order survives a reload and is the same for a crew user of the same team. Rename works: Enter saves (title updated, cyan dot shown, the drag order is unaffected), Esc cancels with no PUT, blur saves, the reset button restores the default name, typing the original name or clearing the field resets it, and maxLength is 40. Names survive a reload and are shared both ways: a crew rename shows for the manager after a focus refetch. × remove and restore keep the card's place and its custom name. Job-set toggles work. All 9 of 9 sparklines animate. On mobile at 390 px, touch drag works after the fix, swiping the card body scrolls the page rather than dragging, nothing overflows sideways, and tapping a title opens the input. There were no page errors.

minor.issue: Each item in 'order' has no length limit (only the list is capped at 200), so very long id strings are accepted.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. ChannelCard took dragHandle, onRename, renamed and defaultTitle as props but never rendered them. It still rendered a plain {title}, and EditableTitle was imported but unused. So channel-*-drag-handle and channel-*-title did not exist in the DOM, and neither drag nor rename could be used. The title span now renders {dragHandle} and .

FIXED BY TESTER. The global rule in index.css (`button, a, [role=button] { touch-action: manipulation }`) comes after the Tailwind utilities, so it overrode the handle's `touch-none`. The computed value was 'manipulation', so the browser started a pan and fired pointercancel, and touch drag never reordered anything. Fixed by adding an inline style={{touchAction:'none'}} on the handle. Verified with CDP touch events: the order changes, and swiping the card body still scrolls.

issues: The 'JOB SET' label wraps onto two lines because the hint text next to it ('drag ⠿ to reorder · tap a name to rename · shared with crew') is long. Put the hint on its own line on small screens.
The drag handle is about 18x18 px, well under the 44 px touch-target guideline. Make the hit area bigger on mobile with padding or a negative margin.

action_items: Review and keep the tester's two fixes: OperatorCards.jsx now renders dragHandle and EditableTitle, and the ChannelsPanel.jsx handle has an inline touchAction none. Or move the touch-action rule into @layer base so Tailwind utilities can override it.

Optional: the PUT sends the whole {order, names} document from local state, so the last write wins. If crew member A renames a card and crew member B drags a card within the 30 s poll window (before B refetches), B's PUT silently removes A's rename, and the reverse. Use PATCH-style partial updates (only the changed name or only the order) or merge on the server.
Optional: make the drag handle touch target bigger on mobile and stop the JOB SET label wrapping.
critical_code_review_comments: useTeamChannelConfig.save PUTs the full config from local state, so concurrent edits from two users overwrite each other (last writer wins). Polling is every 30 s plus on window focus.

useTeamChannelConfig: setOrder and rename read `cfg` from the render closure. Two quick changes in the same tick (for example a rename on blur caused by starting a drag) could drop one of them. Use the functional setState form.
EditableTitle: the reset button uses onMouseDown with preventDefault to stop the blur from committing first. This works, and it also fired on touch-emulated tests.
With PointerSensor listed first, touch input is captured by PointerSensor (distance 6) and not by the 150 ms delayed TouchSensor. This is fine because only the handle activates a drag.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Channel slots are channel-slot-<key> inside channel-grid, and the DOM order is the displayed order. Handles are channel-<key>-drag-handle. Mouse drag: mouse.down, a small move, then about 25 steps to the target. Keyboard: focus the handle, Space, Arrow, Space. Mobile touch: use CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent with has_touch and is_mobile, because Playwright tap cannot drag. Rename uses channel-<key>-title, -title-input and -title-reset-btn (the reset button only shows when the card is renamed). PUTs are debounced by 500 ms. Run pytest without -p no:xdist.
